rag.text:
Test: TC-2507 — Global - Platform connection warnings - Task Configuration - General Synchronization default settings after connecting Trello External platform
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-374 Global - Platform connection warnings
Labels: manual, teamextplatform

Steps:
1. Navigate to Box configuration  > Tasks > Scope configuration of BoxName
   Data: BoxName: TC-2507Global - Platform connection warnings - Task Configuration - General Synchronization default settings after connecting Trello External platform
   Expected: Only main platform is visible
2. Click add new integration and add Trello connection
   Data: Instruction page https://wiki.softwareplant.com/pages/viewpage.action?spaceKey=SOFTWAREPLANT&title=How+to+add+Trello+extPlatform
   Expected: Trello connection successfully added and visible in the box scope.
3. Navigate to BigPicture App settings -> General -> Fields
   Expected: BigPicture Configuration page appears and is correctly working
4. Expand Trello connection
   Expected: All the switchers are now visible and General synchronization settings
appear
5. Verify additional default tasks settings
   Expected: # Calculate tasks automatically based on assignee's working days -  enabled
# Overwrite Jira task data with data from the App - disabled
6. Verify that switchers can be changed
   Expected: # Calculate tasks automatically based on assignee's working days -  enabled
# Overwrite Jira task data with data from the App - disabled and blocked to change

After changing the 1 switcher colour of the button changes to green
